notes.title: Game rebalance update!
notes.content: [p]The game was rebalanced and the various game mechanics and thresholds for the simulation part were adjusted to better capture player's attention, keeps them occupied and entertained! There are also a few new cards which provide better variety for the game :)[/p][p][/p]
